chapter: Joe Liggins and back to Kid Ory
title: Being fired by Ory after a vacation
summary: Back from vacation, Joe found Bob McCracken in his place, was handed a notice because of friction with Ory's wife Barbara, and quit; Harvey Brooks was let go soon after.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, what happened, I went on a vacation. And like I said, I never got along with Barbara, that girl. She was still.. He left his wife for her, and he married Barbara. And when I took off, the first night I got back on the job Bob McCracken was working in my place. So Ory

handed me a two-week notice. He handed me an envelope, and I was wondering what it was, and I opened it -- and I said, "Heck, you can keep Bob here." So I just packed up and went off. And old Braud says, "Oh, don't do that." And I remember Braud and Begidian(?) tried to talk me into...
Yeah. I says, "No, I don't want to stay in the band with him." And they said, "Why did they fire you on account of that..." I knew what it was right off, when the thing happened. But however...
Was Ory... Some people have said Ory was more of a tyrannical leader, you know.
Yeah. As a matter of fact, right after that, Harvey had left the band.
Harvey Brooks. Me and Harvey was in the band together. And he let Harvey go and got Honoré. And this...
I was wondering when Gideon Honoré came into that.
And after that, right after that... Well, come 1954... Right after I left the band, I had an offer to go back east to play with the Rhythm Kings.
